# Skernish Ferry Company - sailing log

One row per sailing; vehicles and foot_passengers count what the crossing carried. The log holds the two most recent seasons, 2025 and 2026.

turns.prompt: Skernish Ferry Company reports how its traffic moves between seasons. By how many foot passengers did the June 2026 sailings exceed the June 2025 sailings? Give the answer as a number alone. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
